

`relocateDocThreads` and `relocateRuleThreads` per Decisions, hooked into
the lowest writers and nowhere else. Verify each site before touching it:

- `updateDocBodyPinned` (`internal/store/docs.go`): read `docs.body`
  before the `UPDATE docs SET body`; after `rebuildSections` (which runs
  `storeSpecTemplate`), read the settled body and call
  `relocateDocThreads(tx, id, version-1, version, old, new)`.
- `publishPatch` (`internal/store/docpatch.go`): same, with `d.body` as
  the old text; `PatchDoc` amends an accepted spec in place, and its open
  `doc_id` threads carry to the new version like any other edit.
- `AcceptRevision` (`internal/store/docrevisions.go`): same, `d.body` to
  the landed candidate's template.
- `normalizeDoc`'s accepted arm (`internal/store/inlinerefs.go`): same, the
  draft and plan arm goes through `UpdateDocBody` and needs nothing.
- `reviseRule` draft arm (`internal/store/rules.go`): read the current
  `rule_versions.body` before the `UPDATE`, then
  `relocateRuleThreads(tx, id, version, version, old, body)`.
- `bumpRuleVersion` (`internal/store/versions.go`): read version `v`'s body
  before the `INSERT` of `v+1`, then `relocateRuleThreads(tx, ruleID, v,
  v+1, old, body)`. This covers `reviseRule`'s accepted arm and
  `normalizeRule`'s, and `syncRules` → `reviseRule` on a spec write.

Each helper selects `open` threads with a byte range on that subject and
`fromVersion`, runs `review.Relocate(old, new, byte_start, byte_end,
quote)`, and writes the move (`version = toVersion`, new range, re-derived
`doc_anchor`) or the `obsolete` resolution with its
`wl:ReviewThreadResolved` event. No exported `RelocateThreads`: nothing
outside the store should be able to relocate without writing. Extend
`TestOnlyBumpFunctionsWriteVersions`'s pattern with a test that greps
`internal/store` for `UPDATE docs SET body` and `rule_versions` writes and
requires each site to be one of the six named above, so a new writer fails
the build until it relocates.

First store test:

```go
func TestBodyWriteRelocates(t *testing.T) {
    // draft rule text "a\nb\ntarget := 1\nc\n"; open thread T on "target := 1".
    // EditRule to "x\ny\n" + text → T open, version unchanged, range moved, DocAnchor unchanged.
    // EditRule to "a\nb\nc\n" → T obsolete, resolved_at set, event wl:ReviewThreadResolved{obsolete}.
    // accept the rule; open thread U on v1; EditRule (new draft v2) → U at version 2, v1's row untouched.
    // draft plan at v1; thread P on a quote; UpdateDocBody with two lines inserted above → P at version 2, moved.
    // accepted spec at vN; thread D on template text; PatchDoc with --note moving the template → D at vN+1, moved.
    // thread Q spanning "two\nthree" in a wrapped paragraph; UpdateDocBody with the paragraph on one line → Q found (whitespace-insensitive).
    // a bare note with doc_anchor only on any of the above → untouched throughout.
}
```
